中国经济.title: China gold market update: Official buying accelerated in August | Post by Ray Jia | Insights
中国经济.content: The PBoC reported a 20.2t gold reserve addition in August, the largest monthly increase since October 2023 (Chart 5). Official gold holdings have now risen for 22 consecutive months, reaching 2,387t by the end of August and accounting for 9% of total foreign exchange reserves, up from 8% in July. This underscores the central bank’s commitment to strengthening reserve diversification and resilience in an increasingly uncertain geopolitical environment.

中国经济.content:
China’s State Administration of Foreign Exchange reported on September 7, 2026 that the People’s Bank of China added 650,000 troy ounces of gold in August. That extends its buying streak to 22 consecutive months, the longest run on record.
